title: Sir Oliver Bibbs, drummer and bandleader in Chicago
summary: Punch recalls working with drummer Sir Oliver Bibbs at Chicago clubs and in Springfield; Allen asks about his leaving Chicago.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I played there a good while for him.

Now I tell you another fella I forgot about. I was making a record. He didn't make no. You might have heard of him, but I wasn't in a long time. Sir Oliver Bibbs. Sir Oliver Bibbs. Yeah, that's where he'd give his name. I waited with him in Chicago at the club silhouette. I waited at the Gehrig Ball. I waited in Springfield with him at the club. Did he have a band? Yeah, he owned a band. Sir Oliver Bibbs.
You left Chicago in 1945, you were saying. 49. 49. 49.
